emergency.title: Emergency Care Services
emergency.subtitle: If you or someone nearby is experiencing acute chest pain, severe breathlessness, stroke symptoms, major trauma, or uncontrolled bleeding, do not wait. Immediate medical attention is available round-the-clock.
emergency.charterTitle: Emergency Treatment is Never Contingent on Payment or VIP Priority
emergency.charterBody: At SmartCare, emergency admission, resuscitation, and life-saving stabilization are administered strictly on the basis of clinical urgency (triage acuity). Emergency treatment is never dependent on paying extra money, deposits, or purchasing commercial priority passes. Every citizen receives immediate, impartial life-saving intervention.
emergency.pillar1Desc: Immediate critical care starts before any administrative billing formalities.
emergency.pillar2Desc: Cases are sorted by vital parameters (Airway, Breathing, Circulation).
emergency.pillar3Desc: Strict adherence to clinical ethics and national trauma protocols.
emergency.triageSubtitle: Upon arrival at the ER, a specialized triage nursing officer evaluates vitals to assign immediate care:
emergency.redDesc: Cardiac arrest, severe respiratory failure, unconsciousness, massive arterial hemorrhage, major vehicular trauma.
emergency.yellowDesc: Severe asthma attack, open fractures, persistent high fever with seizures, intense abdominal colic, deep lacerations.
emergency.greenDesc: Minor sprains, mild abrasions, chronic backache, suture removals. Patients are safely routed to regular OPD counters.
emergency.firstAidTitle: What To Do While Help Is On The Way
emergency.haPoint1: Have the patient sit down in a relaxed half-sitting position with knees bent.
emergency.haPoint2: Loosen tight clothing around neck and waist.
emergency.haPoint3: Do not give heavy food or water. Keep patient calm and reassure them.
emergency.haPoint4: Call 108 or our Emergency Desk immediately.
emergency.strokeFaceText: Ask to smile. Does one side of the face droop?
emergency.strokeArmsText: Ask to raise both arms. Does one arm drift downward?
emergency.strokeSpeechText: Ask to repeat a simple sentence. Is speech slurred?
emergency.strokeTimeText: Call emergency immediately. Note the exact time symptoms started.
emergency.rampDesc: Dedicated North Gate Ramp (Gate 2). Direct stretcher access into Trauma Bay Room 01. Open 24/7/365.
